senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; יָרָה)teaching, law, esp. ת׳(ה) the Law of Moses, Pentateuch; in gen. the Jewish law, Religion.
units: Ber. 5ᵃ (ref. to Ex. XXIV, 12) ת׳ זה מקרא וכ׳ torah means the Pentateuch, ‘and the mitsvah’ means the Mishnah, ‘which I have written’ means the Phrophets and Hagiographa &c.

<cite ref="Exodus 24:12">Ib.</cite> <he>כל העוסק בַּתּ׳ וכ׳</he> he that is engaged in the study of the Law &c., v. <cite ref="B00150"><he>בָּדַל</he></cite>. Ib. 6ᵃ <he>דינא נמי היינו ת׳</he> holding court is also considered a religious act, opp. <he>שלמא בעלמא</he> mere preservation of peace. Ib. 31ᵃ <he>הי ת׳ והי מצוה וכ׳</he> where is the Law, and where the good deeds, that they may save us? <cite ref="Pesachim 87b:20">Pes. 87ᵇ</cite> <he>שקרוב לשונם ללשון ת׳</he> because their (the Babylonians’) language comes near the language of the Torah.
<cite ref="Megillah 3a:21">Meg. 3ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>תלמוד ת׳</he> (abbrev. <he>ת״ת</he>) the study of the Law.
<cite ref="Nedarim 81a:2">Ned. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>הזהרו … שמהם תצא ת׳</he> take heed of the children of the poor, for from them the Law goes forth; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 9:6">Gen. R. s. 9</cite>, a. fr. <he>בתוֹרָתוֹ של ר׳ מאיר</he> in R. Meir’s (annotated) copy of the Law.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 3:3:11">Y. Bicc. III, 65ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>אין הת׳ עומדת מפני בנה</he> the Torah does not rise before her son, i.e. he that is engaged in the study of the Law need not rise when a scholar passes.

<cite ref="Sotah 47b:22">Sot. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>הת׳ חזרה וכ׳</he> the Law goes around begging for students.—<he>ת׳ שבכתב</he>, <he>ת׳ שבעל פה</he>, v. <cite ref="K01341"><he>כְּתָב</he></cite>.—<he>ספר ת׳</he>, v. <cite ref="O01422"><he>סֵפֶר</he></cite>.—<he>תּוֹרַת כהנים</he>, v. <cite ref="K00163"><he>כֹּהֵן</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>תּוֹרוֹת</he>.

Sabb. 31ᵃ כמה ת׳ יש לכם how many laws have you? Sot. l. c. רבו … ונעשית תורה כשתי ת׳ differences increased in Israel, and the Law became like two laws; a. e.—2) definition, designation; character, nature.
<cite ref="Beitzah 10a:3">Bets. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>דאיכא תורת כלי עליו</he> because it bears the denomination of an utensil (v. <cite ref="V00141"><he>תּוֹאַר</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 62a:14">B. Mets. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>בתורת פקדון אתא לידיה</he> it came into his possession as a trust; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 62b:1">ib. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>בתורת זביני</he> as a sold object.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 50b:6">Kidd. 50ᵇ</cite> <he>לא נחית לתורת קידושין</he> he had not come down to any form of betrothal (had not done anything to intimate his intention of betrothal); a. fr.
